_general_descriptions.symbol: The asset symbol to analyze. Choose from asset_options below or use any valid Twelve Data symbol.

timeframes.high: Higher timeframe for detecting liquidity sweeps and overall structure. Options: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1h, 4h, 1day
timeframes.mid: Mid timeframe for Event B (BOS/IFVG) and validation. Should be smaller than high TF.
timeframes.low: Lowest timeframe for entry confirmation and trade execution. Should be smallest of all three.

_descriptions.use_fvg_validation: When true, FVG respect is checked first and takes priority. If an FVG is touched/respected, validation triggers immediately without checking equilibrium.
_descriptions.use_equilibrium_validation: When true, checks if price enters the premium/discount zone (above/below equilibrium). For SHORT: trigger when price enters premium. For LONG: trigger when price enters discount.
_descriptions.require_fvg_in_equilibrium: OVERRIDES other settings when true. Requires an FVG that structurally overlaps with the equilibrium zone to be touched. This is the strictest validation mode.

_usage_notes.mode_priority: require_fvg_in_equilibrium takes precedence over the other two settings. When true, the other flags are ignored.
recommended_modes: FVG priority with equilibrium fallback: use_fvg_validation=true, use_equilibrium_validation=true

_descriptions.enabled: When true, runs backtest simulation on found signals. Set to false to only scan for setups without simulating trades.
_descriptions.initial_capital: Starting capital in USD for the backtest. Trades use full capital (compounding).
_descriptions.hold_overnight: When false (default), exits all positions at market close (intraday only). When true, allows holding positions overnight.
_descriptions.bos_exit_enabled: When true, exits trades early if an opposing BOS (Break of Structure) signal appears while in profit.
_descriptions.bos_exit_threshold_percent: Minimum profit as percentage of TP target required before BOS exit is allowed. E.g., 50 means you need 50% of the way to TP before early exit triggers.
_descriptions.min_profit_percent: Skip trades where expected profit (entry to TP) is below this percentage. Set to 0 to disable.
_descriptions.trend_filter_enabled: When true, uses ARMA analysis to determine market trend and filters trades against it. Bullish trend = only LONG trades. Bearish trend = only SHORT trades. Neutral = all trades allowed.
_descriptions.trend_filter_lookback: Number of mid-timeframe candles to use for ARMA trend calculation. Higher values = smoother/longer-term trend detection.

_usage_notes.trend_filter: The ARMA model calculates a Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR). If SNR < 0.05, trend is considered 'neutral' and no filtering occurs. This prevents false signals from noisy/sideways markets.
_usage_notes.compounding: Capital compounds after each trade. Wins increase position size, losses decrease it.
_usage_notes.exit_priority: TP/SL are checked first, then BOS exit (if enabled), then market close (if intraday only).

_descriptions.visualize: When true, generates an interactive HTML visualization of all sweeps with step-by-step analysis.
_descriptions.export_journal: Controls trade journal CSV export. Options: 'auto' (saves to results/trades/{symbol}_trades.csv), a custom filepath, or false to disable.

asset_options._description: Reference lists of available symbols organized by category. Use any of these values for the 'symbol' field above.
